routeReason: The feedback changes the core cut-reward loop and must be proven on the default natural journey, not only through score state assertions.

evidence.referenceObservation: Each successful cut shows an immediate floating money delta near the hit while the persistent total at the top updates continuously; the player can read per-cut earnings before the next action.
evidence.currentRuntimeObservation: The default path updates a score counter and emits a generic +value feedback pop, but it does not present an authored earnings event with consistent currency semantics and a clearly paired total update.

reproductionMatrix.rendererPresentationPath: game-core cut event → main.ts spawnFeedback → HUD counterText
reproductionMatrix.naturalInput: normal tap/flip cutting without debug placement
reproductionMatrix.result: score changes are present, but per-cut earnings, total balance and impact location are not consistently presented as one readable reward beat

reproductionMatrix.rendererPresentationPath: finish event → terminal reward label → score counter
reproductionMatrix.naturalInput: normal approach into a visible reward lane
reproductionMatrix.result: final multiplier is shown after settlement, but the immediate earned amount is not shown as a real-time currency delta at the wall contact

acceptanceCriteria: Every natural cut produces a player-visible per-cut earnings delta at the contact location or a clearly anchored nearby position.
The persistent total updates in the same feedback window and uses one consistent currency/score vocabulary.
The feedback remains readable at desktop and 390x844 mobile without relying on helper text alone.
Finish multiplier settlement shows the multiplier effect and resulting earnings as a visible event before the terminal overlay obscures the wall.
claimBoundary: Reference behavior is abstracted as feedback timing and attribution only; reference economy values are not copied.
